Package br.edu.unipampa.varzinho

package br.edu.unipampa.varzinho
VarZinho's entry points: Main opens the window, and ConsoleDemo runs the whole capture flow in text, with no window.

Neither holds a rule. Main hands over to bootstrap/, which puts the application together; ConsoleDemo only drives the domain and prints what happened.
